## Testing Performed

Describe manual checks and commands run.

## Security Checklist

- [ ] Input validation checked.
- [ ] Authorization checked.
- [ ] CSRF/auth requirements checked.
- [ ] No secrets committed.
- [ ] No raw sensitive data in logs/errors.
- [ ] File access and download permissions checked if relevant.
- [ ] AI provider keys are never exposed to browser code.

## Documentation Checklist

- [ ] README/docs updated if needed.
- [ ] Changelog updated if needed.
- [ ] OpenAPI/API docs updated or compatibility checked if needed.
